title.narrative: Number of countries operating Eduroam

description.narrative: Number of countries operating Eduroamtaken from the LF, phrasing revised

comment.narrative: According to the ResultsOriented Monitoring ROM mission Eduroam was introduced in Georgia Armenia and Belarus in Ukraine it was already available since 2015 but it was improved and developed.
Target countries are all the EaP countries Armenia Azerbaijan Belarus Georgia Moldova Ukraine. The mentioned target states that all countries need to operate Eduroam after the end of year 2 2017.

Last available value refers to end of 2017. Eduroam service was deployed successfully in all six beneficiary partner countries. The number of service locations increased as well as the number of national and international users of the service. Eduroam coverage increased by 470 over all in the region from 38 to 179 service locations with the most significant increase in Ukraine from six to 98 service locations.
